query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE transfers SET account_id = $2, status = $3, reference = $4, score = $5 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO transfer_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($6, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $7, unnested.event_type, unnested.event FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($8::TEXT[], $9::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event) RETURNING recorded_at
